name: Client
definition: A person who is a bank customer, identified by client_id and carrying demographic attributes: gender, birth_date and a district of residence.
scope: Customer-level analysis across accounts, dispositions, loans and transactions.

name: Account
definition: A bank account identified by account_id, opened on a date at a particular district branch, and carrying a statement-issuance frequency.
scope: Account-level analysis of balances, statements, loans and transactions.

name: District
definition: An administrative district (okres) of the Czech Republic, identified by district_id and carrying a name, a region and socio-economic attributes encoded in columns A2-A16.
scope: Geographic and socio-economic context for clients and accounts.

name: Disposition
definition: A record in the disp table that links exactly one client to exactly one account and states the role that client holds on that account.
scope: Resolving which clients are attached to which accounts and in what role.

name: Loan
definition: A loan contract granted on an account, carrying an approval date, principal amount, duration in months, periodic payment and a status code.
scope: Credit analysis: approval timing, amounts, terms and contract status.

name: Transaction
definition: A single money movement recorded on an account, carrying a date, a direction, an operation mode, an amount, the resulting balance and an optional purpose code.
scope: Account activity analysis: deposits, withdrawals and transfers.

name: Card
definition: A payment card issued against a disposition record, carrying a card type and an issuance date.
scope: Card issuance analysis; not exercised by the construction workload.

name: Standing Order
definition: A recurring bank order defined on an account towards an external counterparty, carrying a counterparty bank, counterparty account, amount and purpose code.
scope: Recurring payment analysis; not exercised by the construction workload.

name: Statement Frequency
definition: The cadence at which the bank issues a statement for an account, recorded as a coded value on the account: monthly, weekly, or issued after each transaction.
scope: Any question about how often a statement is issued or about clients/accounts that choose a particular issuance mode.

name: Loan Status
definition: The state of a loan contract expressed as a single-letter status code recorded on the loan record.
scope: Questions about whether a contract is still running, finished, or problematic.

name: Transaction Direction
definition: The direction class of a transaction as recorded in trans.type: money credited to the account versus money debited from it.
scope: Separating incoming from outgoing movements.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: The detailed mode of a transaction as recorded in trans.operation: cash deposit, cash withdrawal, card withdrawal, transfer in or transfer out.
scope: Identifying how a movement was performed, independently of its direction.

name: Cash Withdrawal
definition: The analytical concept of taking cash out of an account; in this database it is expressed by the operation code VYBER.
scope: Questions about withdrawals in cash or cash transactions, as distinct from transfers and card operations.

name: Transaction Purpose Code
definition: The coded purpose or counterparty category of a transaction as recorded in trans.k_symbol, such as interest, bank services, standing order, pension, insurance or loan repayment.
scope: Classifying transactions by what they were for.

name: Standing Order Purpose Code
definition: The coded purpose of a recurring bank order as recorded in order.k_symbol.
scope: Classifying recurring orders by what they are for.

name: Disposition Role
definition: The role a client holds on an account, recorded in disp.type: OWNER (the account owner) or DISPONENT (an authorised user of the account).
scope: Determining who owns an account versus who is merely authorised on it.

name: Client Gender
definition: The recorded gender of a client, stored as a single-letter code.
scope: Gender-based segmentation of clients.

name: District Name
definition: The human-readable name of a district, stored in district.A2.
scope: Reporting a district by name.

name: District Region
definition: The larger geographic region to which a district belongs, stored in district.A3.
scope: Grouping or filtering districts by region.

name: Account Opening District
definition: The district attached to an account record, i.e. the district of the branch where the account was opened.
scope: Questions about where an account was opened; must not be confused with the client's district of residence.

name: Client Residence District
definition: The district attached to a client record, i.e. the district in which the client lives.
scope: Questions about where clients live or stay; must not be confused with the account's branch district.

name: Account Opening Date
definition: The date on which an account was opened, recorded on the account record.
scope: Temporal filtering and cohorting of accounts.

name: Loan Approval Date
definition: The date on which a loan contract was granted or approved, recorded on the loan record.
scope: Temporal filtering of loans by approval time.

name: Client Birth Date
definition: The date of birth of a client.
scope: Age-related and date-of-birth identification of clients.

name: Loan Amount
definition: The principal amount of a loan contract as recorded on the loan record.
scope: Sizing loans and applying amount thresholds; also the approved amount of the contract.

name: Loan Duration
definition: The agreed term of a loan contract, expressed in months.
scope: Comparing loan terms; the basis of statements such as loan validity longer than 12 months.

name: Loan Payment
definition: The contractual periodic instalment amount of a loan contract.
scope: Assessing the repayment burden of a loan; not exercised by the construction workload.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: The monetary amount moved by a single transaction.
scope: Sizing individual movements and summing activity.

name: Transaction Balance
definition: The account balance recorded immediately after a transaction.
scope: Tracking account balance over time.

name: District Average Salary
definition: The average salary recorded for a district, stored in district.A11.
scope: Socio-economic characterisation of districts; basis of salary thresholds in questions.

name: Account Loan Total Amount
definition: The total approved loan amount attributed to an account, obtained by aggregating the amounts of the loan contracts held on that account.
scope: Per-account loan sizing when an account may hold more than one contract.

name: Conditional Share Percentage
definition: The share of a conditioned subgroup within a base population, expressed as a percentage; the measured quantity may be a count of records or a summed amount.
scope: Requests phrased as what percentage of a group satisfies a condition.
